listing.name: Super Mario Odyssey (smo-recomp)
listing.summary: Build this Windows port of Super Mario Odyssey from your own extracted 1.4.1 Switch game. The project reports manual play from Cap Kingdom to a Cascade Kingdom checkpoint. Some tests used 1.0.0, and the additions in 1.4.1 remain untested.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Supply your decrypted, updated 1.4.1 program, complete merged RomFS and update control data. This extracted-file route requires no separate keys or firmware.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Build the Windows x64 Vulkan player from source using LLVM 9, the VS2019 SDK, the Vulkan SDK, SDL3 and Python. Use Windows 10 or 11 with Vulkan 1.3 and the extensions listed by the project.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The development system used an RTX 4090. The project offers no release package, online play or confirmed route on another desktop OS.
